scripts.typecheck: pnpm run types:gen && if [ -d ui ]; then pnpm --dir ui run typecheck; fi && if [ -d api ]; then pnpm --dir api run typecheck; fi && if [ -d plugins ]; then for dir in plugins/*; do if [ -f "$dir/package.json" ]; then pnpm --dir "$dir" run typecheck; fi; done; fi
scripts.test: pnpm --dir api run test --if-present && pnpm --dir ui run test --if-present && for d in plugins/*; do [ -f "$d/package.json" ] && pnpm --dir "$d" run test --if-present; done
scripts.dev:postgres: docker compose up -d --wait && pnpm run dev
scripts.dev:postgres:reset: docker compose down -v && docker compose up -d --wait
scripts.release: echo 'Packages versioned - app release handled by workflow'
